summary: One week to Expo (Nov 4). Booth ships Thursday; print files sent, booth script final, Coastal ranking and scoring API done. Harbor (38% of revenue) renews Oct 30, but legal sent redlines wanting an uptime clause. Pinecrest kickoff is Thursday; 10x load test at 2pm.

items.text: Harbor's legal sent redlines overnight and wants an uptime clause before signing. Renewal is Oct 30. TW-154 (Maya, review redlines, due Oct 29) is todo; TW-158 paperwork waits on the clause being agreed.
Jordan owns TW-158, new Harbor renewal order form with legal's changes, due Oct 30, todo. It follows agreement on the uptime clause.
Dana (Harbor) asked for a monthly sync uptime report (TW-155, Arjun, 3h) and a weekly Monday auto-export (TW-156, Nina, 2h). No dates given; both todo, low priority.
Harbor (38% of revenue) renews Oct 30 with uptime-clause redlines open. QBR notes, 4-week trend and sync alerts to its ops channel were already done.
Ridgeline (22% of revenue, health yellow) renews Nov 20. Renewal prep TW-113 is in progress, due Nov 13.
Pinecrest kickoff confirmed for Thursday. TW-151 (kickoff and data access) is in progress, owned by Jordan, due Oct 29. Pinecrest wants to be live before Expo.
Booth print files went to the printer (TW-150 done). Booth ships Thursday. Sam created TW-157 (booth slide loop), due Oct 31, todo.

Demo run time is now 1:50, under the 2-minute target. Maya's booth script TW-120 is done. TW-119 (demo flow and sample data, due Oct 30) remains in progress; screen 3 was waiting on slot picker build.
Nina's 10x load test (TW-143, due Oct 30) starts at 2pm today. Arjun reports the scoring API (TW-115) is done and load tested.
Nina shipped the Coastal ranking changes (TW-138 done). TW-148 (caching slot scores for booth demo) is in progress, due Oct 30.

TW-147 (demo environment) is in progress, due Oct 29. It still needs Coastal's anonymized week loaded. TW-146 (rate limits for booth traffic) moved to in progress, due Oct 30. Arjun says nothing is blocking him.
Leila says booth tablet mode works on the iPad. TW-149 is still in progress, due Oct 29. She also moved dark mode TW-108 to in progress.
TW-121 (Coastal and Valley live on Smart Slots, due Oct 30) is in progress. Valley booked 140 slots earlier; Pinecrest is the third design partner, signed with TW-126 done.
Maya moved the investor-meetings ticket TW-152 (four meetings at the booth, due Oct 30) and the launch post TW-153 (due Nov 3) to in progress.
Booth staffing is two people at a time, in shifts. The shift plan is to be locked Thursday.
Jordan's Smart Slots help center articles (TW-124, three articles for launch) are in progress, due Nov 3.
